papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：平仮名/ひらがな（Hiragana）学习

q.zh: 平假名“あ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "あ"?

exp.zh: あ (a) 是五十音图的第一个假名
exp.en: "あ" (a) is the first hiragana character in the 50-sound chart

q.zh: 平假名“い”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "い"?

exp.zh: い (i) 发音类似于英语 "see" 中的 "ee"
exp.en: "い" (i) is pronounced like "ee" in "see"

q.zh: 平假名“う”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "う"?

exp.zh: う (u) 发音时嘴唇扁平，不向前突出
exp.en: "う" (u) is pronounced with unrounded lips.

q.zh: 平假名“え”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "え"?

exp.zh: え (e) 发音类似于英文中的 "e" (bed)
exp.en: "え" (e) is pronounced like "e" in "bed"

q.zh: 平假名“お”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "お"?

exp.zh: お (o) 发音嘴唇圆拢
exp.en: "お" (o) is pronounced like "o" in "go"

q.zh: 平假名“か”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "か"?

exp.zh: か (ka) 由辅音 k 与元音 a 拼读
exp.en: "か" (ka) is the combination of consonant 'k' and vowel 'a'

q.zh: 平假名“き”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "き"?

exp.zh: き (ki) 读作 ki
exp.en: "き" (ki) is pronounced like "key"

q.zh: 平假名“く”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "く"?

exp.zh: く (ku) 字形像一个小于号“<”
exp.en: "く" (ku) looks like a "less than" sign (<)

q.zh: 平假名“け”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "け"?

exp.zh: け (ke) 读作 "k" + "e"
exp.en: "け" (ke) is pronounced like "k" + "e"

q.zh: 平假名“こ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "こ"?

exp.zh: こ (ko) 读作 "coat" 里的 "co"
exp.en: "こ" (ko) is pronounced like "co" in "coat"

q.zh: 平假名“さ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "さ"?

exp.zh: さ 读作 sa
exp.en: "さ" (sa) is pronounced like "sa" in "salad"

q.zh: 平假名“し”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "し"?

exp.zh: し 为特例发音，读作 shi，发音类似英语的 "she"
exp.en: "し" (shi) is an exception in the Sa-row, pronounced like "she"

q.zh: 平假名“す”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "す"?

exp.zh: す 读作 su
exp.en: "す" (su) is pronounced like "s" + "u"

q.zh: 平假名“せ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "せ"?

exp.zh: せ 读作 se ，发音类似英语的 "say"
exp.en: "せ" (se) is pronounced like "say"

q.zh: 平假名“そ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "そ"?

exp.zh: そ 读作 so，读法类似英语的 “so”
exp.en: "そ" (so) is pronounced like "so"

q.zh: 平假名“た”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "た"?

exp.zh: た 读作 ta，读法类似英语 “target” 的 “ta”
exp.en: "た" (ta) is pronounced like "ta" in "target"

q.zh: 平假名“ち”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ち"?

exp.zh: ち 为特例发音，读作 chi
exp.en: "ち" (chi) is an exception in the Ta-row, pronounced like "cheese"

q.zh: 平假名“つ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "つ"?

exp.zh: つ 发音类似英语 "tsunami" 中的 "tsu"
exp.en: "つ" (tsu) is pronounced like "ts" in "tsunami"

q.zh: 平假名“て”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "て"?

exp.zh: て 读作 te
exp.en: "て" (te) is pronounced like "tell"

q.zh: 平假名“と”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "と"?

exp.zh: と 读作 to，发音类似英语的 “toe”
exp.en: "と" (to) is pronounced like "toe"

q.zh: 平假名“な”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "な"?

exp.zh: な 读作 na
exp.en: "な" (na) is pronounced like "na" in "napa"

q.zh: 平假名“に”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "に"?

exp.zh: に 读作 ni，发音类似英语的 “knee”
exp.en: "に" (ni) is pronounced like "knee"

q.zh: 平假名“ぬ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ぬ"?

exp.zh: ぬ 读作 nu
exp.en: "ぬ" (nu) is pronounced like "noodle"

q.zh: 平假名“ね”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ね"?

exp.zh: ね 读作 ne
exp.en: "ね" (ne) is pronounced like "net"

q.zh: 平假名“の”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "の"?

exp.zh: の 读作 no，发音类似英语的 “no”
exp.en: "の" (no) is pronounced like "no"

q.zh: 平假名“は”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "は"?

exp.zh: は 独立使用时读作 ha
exp.en: "は" (ha) is pronounced like "ha" in "ha-ha"

q.zh: 平假名“ひ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ひ"?

exp.zh: ひ 读作 hi，发音类似英语的 “he”
exp.en: "ひ" (hi) is pronounced like "he"

q.zh: 平假名“ふ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ふ"?

exp.zh: ふ 发音介于 hu 与 fu 之间
exp.en: "ふ" (fu) is a soft sound between "hu" and "fu"

q.zh: 平假名“へ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "へ"?

exp.zh: へ 读作 he， 发音类似英语 “help” 的 “he”
exp.en: "へ" (he) is pronounced like "help"

q.zh: 平假名“ほ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ほ"?

exp.zh: ほ 读作 ho，发音类似英语 “home” 的 “ho”
exp.en: "ほ" (ho) is pronounced like "home"

q.zh: 平假名“ま”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ま"?

exp.zh: ま 读作 ma
exp.en: "ま" (ma) is pronounced like "mama"

q.zh: 平假名“み”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "み"?

exp.zh: み 读作 mi，发音类似英语的 “me”
exp.en: "み" (mi) is pronounced like "me"

q.zh: 平假名“む”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "む"?

exp.zh: む 读作 mu，发音类似英语 “moon” 的 “mo”
exp.en: "む" (mu) is pronounced like "moon"

q.zh: 平假名“め”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "め"?

exp.zh: め 读作 me，发音类似英语 “met” 的 “me”
exp.en: "め" (me) is pronounced like "met"

q.zh: 平假名“も”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "も"?

exp.zh: も 读作 mo，发音类似英语 “more” 的 “mo”
exp.en: "も" (mo) is pronounced like "more"

q.zh: 平假名“や”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "や"?

exp.zh: や  读作 ya，发音类似英语 “yard” 的 “ya”
exp.en: "や" (ya) is pronounced like "yard"

q.zh: 平假名“ゆ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ゆ"?

exp.zh: ゆ 读作 yu，发音类似英语的 “you”
exp.en: "ゆ" (yu) is pronounced like "you"

q.zh: 平假名“よ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "よ"?

exp.zh: よ 读作 yo，发音类似英语 “yoga” 的 “yo”
exp.en: "よ" (yo) is pronounced like "yoga"

q.zh: 平假名“ら”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ら"?

exp.zh: ら 读作ra，日语中的 r 音发音接近轻微的 l 音
exp.en: "ら" is pronounced ra, the Japanese 'r' sound is close to a soft 'l' sound

q.zh: 平假名“り”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "り"?

exp.zh: り 读作 ri
exp.en: "り" (ri) is pronounced like "ree"

q.zh: 平假名“る”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "る"?

exp.zh: る 读作 ru
exp.en: "る" (ru) is pronounced like "roo"

q.zh: 平假名“れ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "れ"?

exp.zh: れ 读作 re，发音类似英语 “red” 的 “re”
exp.en: "れ" (re) is pronounced like "red"

q.zh: 平假名“ろ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ろ"?

exp.zh: ろ 读作 ro，发音类似英语 “row” 的 “ro”
exp.en: "ろ" (ro) is pronounced like "row"

q.zh: 平假名“わ”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "わ"?

exp.zh: わ 读作 wa
exp.en: "わ" (wa) is pronounced like "water"

q.zh: 平假名“を”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "を"?

exp.zh: を (o/wo) 主要用作宾语助词，现代发音通常与“お”相同读作 o
exp.en: "を" (o/wo) is used as an object particle and is usually pronounced the same as "お" (o)

q.zh: 平假名“ん”的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Hiragana "ん"?

exp.zh: ん (n) 是五十音图中唯一的独立拨音（鼻音）
exp.en: "ん" (n) is the only standalone nasal consonant in Japanese

papers.titleZh: 试卷 2：片仮名/カタカナ（Katakana）学习

q.zh: 片假名「ア」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ア?

exp.zh: ア (a) 是五十音图的第一个片假名。
exp.en: ア (a) is the first Katakana character in the 50-sound chart.

q.zh: 片假名「イ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana イ?

exp.zh: イ (i) 发音类似于英语 see 中的 ee。
exp.en: イ (i) is pronounced like 'ee' in 'see'.

q.zh: 片假名「ウ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ウ?

exp.zh: ウ (u) 发音时嘴唇扁平，不向前突出。
exp.en: ウ (u) is pronounced with unrounded lips.

q.zh: 片假名「エ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana エ?

exp.zh: エ (e) 发音类似于英文中的 e (bed)。
exp.en: エ (e) is pronounced like 'e' in 'bed'.

q.zh: 片假名「オ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana オ?

exp.zh: オ (o) 发音嘴唇圆拢。
exp.en: オ (o) is pronounced like 'o' in 'go'.

q.zh: 片假名「カ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana カ?

exp.zh: カ (ka) 源自汉字「加」的左半部分。
exp.en: カ (ka) is derived from the Chinese character 加.

q.zh: 片假名「キ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana キ?

exp.zh: キ (ki) 读作 ki。
exp.en: キ (ki) is pronounced like 'key'.

q.zh: 片假名「ク」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ク?

exp.zh: ク (ku) 源自汉字「久」的左上角。
exp.en: ク (ku) is derived from the Chinese character 久.

q.zh: 片假名「ケ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ケ?

exp.zh: ケ (ke) 读作 ke。
exp.en: ケ (ke) is pronounced like 'k' + 'e'.

q.zh: 片假名「コ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana コ?

exp.zh: コ (ko) 读作 ko。
exp.en: コ (ko) is pronounced like 'co' in 'coat'.

q.zh: 片假名「サ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana サ?

exp.zh: サ (sa) 读作 sa。
exp.en: サ (sa) is pronounced like 'sa' in 'salad'.

q.zh: 片假名「シ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana シ?

exp.zh: シ (shi) 读作 shi，注意笔画方向由下往上，不要与「ツ」搞混。
exp.en: シ (shi) is an exception in the Sa-row, pronounced like 'she'. Pay attention not to confuse it with ツ (tsu).

q.zh: 片假名「ス」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ス?

exp.zh: ス (su) 读作 su。
exp.en: ス (su) is pronounced like 's' + 'u'.

q.zh: 片假名「セ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana セ?

exp.zh: セ (se) 读作 se。
exp.en: セ (se) is pronounced like 'say'.

q.zh: 片假名「ソ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ソ?

exp.zh: ソ (so) 读作 so。
exp.en: ソ (so) is pronounced like 'so'.

q.zh: 片假名「タ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana タ?

exp.zh: タ (ta) 读作 ta。
exp.en: タ (ta) is pronounced like 'ta' in 'target'.

q.zh: 片假名「チ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana チ?

exp.zh: チ (chi) 读作 chi。
exp.en: チ (chi) is an exception in the Ta-row, pronounced like 'cheese'.

q.zh: 片假名「ツ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ツ?

exp.zh: ツ (tsu) 笔画方向由上往下，读作 tsu。
exp.en: ツ (tsu) stroke goes from top to bottom, pronounced 'tsu'.

q.zh: 片假名「テ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana テ?

exp.zh: テ (te) 读作 te。
exp.en: テ (te) is pronounced like 'tell'.

q.zh: 片假名「ト」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ト?

exp.zh: ト (to) 读作 to。
exp.en: ト (to) looks like a tree branch and is pronounced like 'toe'.

q.zh: 片假名「ナ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ナ?

exp.zh: ナ (na) 读作 na。
exp.en: ナ (na) is pronounced like 'na' in 'napa'.

q.zh: 片假名「ニ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ニ?

exp.zh: ニ (ni) 字形像中文数字「二」，读作 ni。
exp.en: ニ (ni) looks like the Chinese number two 二, pronounced 'ni'.

q.zh: 片假名「ヌ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ヌ?

exp.zh: ヌ (nu) 读作 nu。
exp.en: ヌ (nu) is derived from the Chinese character 奴.

q.zh: 片假名「ネ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ネ?

exp.zh: ネ (ne) 读作 ne。
exp.en: ネ (ne) is pronounced like 'net'.

q.zh: 片假名「ノ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ノ?

exp.zh: ノ (no) 为一条单斜线，读作 no。
exp.en: ノ (no) is a single diagonal slash, pronounced 'no'.

q.zh: 片假名「ハ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ハ?

exp.zh: ハ (ha) 字形像中文「八」，读作 ha。
exp.en: ハ (ha) looks like the Chinese character 八, pronounced 'ha'.

q.zh: 片假名「ヒ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ヒ?

exp.zh: ヒ (hi) 读作 hi。
exp.en: ヒ (hi) is pronounced like 'he'.

q.zh: 片假名「フ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana フ?

exp.zh: フ (fu) 发音介于 hu 与 fu 之间。
exp.en: フ (fu) is a soft sound between 'hu' and 'fu'.

q.zh: 片假名「ヘ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ヘ?

exp.zh: ヘ (he) 与平假名「へ」外形几乎一致，读作 he。
exp.en: ヘ (he) is written identical to its Hiragana counterpart へ, pronounced 'he'.

q.zh: 片假名「ホ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ホ?

exp.zh: ホ (ho) 读作 ho。
exp.en: ホ (ho) is pronounced like 'home'.

q.zh: 片假名「マ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana マ?

exp.zh: マ (ma) 读作 ma。
exp.en: マ (ma) is pronounced like 'mama'.

q.zh: 片假名「ミ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ミ?

exp.zh: ミ (mi) 由三条斜线组成，读作 mi。
exp.en: ミ (mi) consists of three parallel lines, pronounced 'mi'.

q.zh: 片假名「ム」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ム?

exp.zh: ム (mu) 读作 mu。
exp.en: ム (mu) is pronounced like 'moon'.

q.zh: 片假名「メ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana メ?

exp.zh: メ (me) 读作 me。
exp.en: メ (me) is pronounced like 'met'.

q.zh: 片假名「モ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana モ?

exp.zh: モ (mo) 读作 mo。
exp.en: モ (mo) is pronounced like 'more'.

q.zh: 片假名「ヤ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ヤ?

exp.zh: ヤ (ya) 读作 ya。
exp.en: ヤ (ya) is pronounced like 'yard'.

q.zh: 片假名「ユ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ユ?

exp.zh: ユ (yu) 读作 yu。
exp.en: ユ (yu) is pronounced like 'you'.

q.zh: 片假名「ヨ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ヨ?

exp.zh: ヨ (yo) 形状类似反向的字母 E，读作 yo。
exp.en: ヨ (yo) looks like a reversed 'E', pronounced 'yo'.

q.zh: 片假名「ラ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ラ?

exp.zh: ラ (ra) 读作 ra。
exp.en: ラ (ra) is pronounced like a soft 'la'.

q.zh: 片假名「リ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana リ?

exp.zh: リ (ri) 读作 ri。
exp.en: リ (ri) is pronounced like 'ree'.

q.zh: 片假名「ル」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ル?

exp.zh: ル (ru) 读作 ru。
exp.en: ル (ru) is pronounced like 'roo'.

q.zh: 片假名「レ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana レ?

exp.zh: レ (re) 读作 re。
exp.en: レ (re) is pronounced like 'red'.

q.zh: 片假名「ロ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ロ?

exp.zh: ロ (ro) 形状像一个方框，读作 ro。
exp.en: ロ (ro) looks like a square box, pronounced 'ro'.

q.zh: 片假名「ワ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ワ?

exp.zh: ワ (wa) 读作 wa。
exp.en: ワ (wa) is pronounced like 'water'.

q.zh: 片假名「ヲ」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ヲ?

exp.zh: ヲ 主要用作宾语助词，现代发音通常与「オ」相同读作 o。
exp.en: ヲ (o/wo) is used as an object particle and is usually pronounced the same as オ (o).

q.zh: 片假名「ン」的正确读音是？
q.en: What is the correct pronunciation of the Katakana ン?

exp.zh: ン (n) 是拨音（鼻音），笔画从左下往右上画，读作 n。
exp.en: ン (n) is the nasal consonant. Stroke direction goes from bottom-left to top-right, pronounced 'n'.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：漢字/かんじ（Kanji）学习

q.zh: 汉字「一」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 一?

exp.zh: 「一」读作 ichi，表示数字 1。
exp.en: 一 is read as ichi, meaning the number 1.

q.zh: 汉字「二」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 二?

exp.zh: 「二」读作 ni，表示数字 2。
exp.en: 二 is read as ni, meaning the number 2.

q.zh: 汉字「三」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 三?

exp.zh: 「三」读作 san，表示数字 3。
exp.en: 三 is read as san, meaning the number 3.

q.zh: 汉字「四」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 四?

exp.zh: 「四」读作 yon 或 shi，两者都可，但 yon 更常用于日常。
exp.en: 四 is read as yon or shi; yon is more common in daily speech.

q.zh: 汉字「五」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 五?

exp.zh: 「五」读作 go，表示数字 5。
exp.en: 五 is read as go, meaning the number 5.

q.zh: 汉字「六」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 六?

exp.zh: 「六」读作 roku，表示数字 6。
exp.en: 六 is read as roku, meaning the number 6.

q.zh: 汉字「七」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 七?

exp.zh: 「七」读作 nana 或 shichi，nana 更常用于避免与「一」混淆。
exp.en: 七 is read as nana or shichi; nana is often used to avoid confusion with ichi.

q.zh: 汉字「八」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 八?

exp.zh: 「八」读作 hachi，表示数字 8。
exp.en: 八 is read as hachi, meaning the number 8.

q.zh: 汉字「九」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 九?

exp.zh: 「九」读作 kyuu 或 ku，kyuu 更常用。
exp.en: 九 is read as kyuu or ku; kyuu is more common.

q.zh: 汉字「十」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 十?

exp.zh: 「十」读作 juu，表示数字 10。
exp.en: 十 is read as juu, meaning the number 10.

q.zh: 汉字「日」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 日 mean?

exp.zh: 「日」表示太阳或日子，如「日曜日」意为星期日。
exp.en: 日 means sun or day, as in 日曜日 (Sunday).

q.zh: 汉字「月」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 月 mean?

exp.zh: 「月」表示月亮或月份，如「月曜日」意为星期一。
exp.en: 月 means moon or month, as in 月曜日 (Monday).

q.zh: 汉字「火」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 火 mean?

exp.zh: 「火」表示火，如「火曜日」意为星期二。
exp.en: 火 means fire, as in 火曜日 (Tuesday).

q.zh: 汉字「水」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 水 mean?

exp.zh: 「水」表示水，如「水曜日」意为星期三。
exp.en: 水 means water, as in 水曜日 (Wednesday).

q.zh: 汉字「木」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 木 mean?

exp.zh: 「木」表示树或木头，如「木曜日」意为星期四。
exp.en: 木 means tree or wood, as in 木曜日 (Thursday).

q.zh: 汉字「金」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 金 mean?

exp.zh: 「金」表示金或钱，如「金曜日」意为星期五。
exp.en: 金 means gold or money, as in 金曜日 (Friday).

q.zh: 汉字「土」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 土 mean?

exp.zh: 「土」表示土或土地，如「土曜日」意为星期六。
exp.en: 土 means earth or soil, as in 土曜日 (Saturday).

q.zh: 汉字「上」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 上 mean?

exp.zh: 「上」表示上方、上面，如「机の上」意为桌子上。
exp.en: 上 means up or above, as in 机の上 (on the desk).

q.zh: 汉字「下」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 下 mean?

exp.zh: 「下」表示下方、下面，如「木の下」意为树下。
exp.en: 下 means down or below, as in 木の下 (under the tree).

q.zh: 汉字「左」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 左 mean?

exp.zh: 「左」表示左边，如「左手」意为左手。
exp.en: 左 means left, as in 左手 (left hand).

q.zh: 汉字「右」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 右 mean?

exp.zh: 「右」表示右边，如「右手」意为右手。
exp.en: 右 means right, as in 右手 (right hand).

q.zh: 汉字「中」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 中 mean?

exp.zh: 「中」表示中间、中央，如「中国」意为中国。
exp.en: 中 means middle or center, as in 中国 (China).

q.zh: 汉字「大」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 大 mean?

exp.zh: 「大」表示大，如「大学」意为大学。
exp.en: 大 means big, as in 大学 (university).

q.zh: 汉字「小」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 小 mean?

exp.zh: 「小」表示小，如「小学校」意为小学。
exp.en: 小 means small, as in 小学校 (elementary school).

q.zh: 汉字「人」的读音是？
q.en: What is the reading of the Kanji 人?

exp.zh: 「人」读作 hito（训读）或 jin/nin（音读），表示人。
exp.en: 人 is read as hito (kun-yomi) or jin/nin (on-yomi), meaning person.

q.zh: 汉字「口」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 口 mean?

exp.zh: 「口」表示嘴巴，如「入口」意为入口。
exp.en: 口 means mouth, as in 入口 (entrance).

q.zh: 汉字「目」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 目 mean?

exp.zh: 「目」表示眼睛，如「目的」原意为目标。
exp.en: 目 means eye, as in 目的 (purpose / target).

q.zh: 汉字「耳」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 耳 mean?

exp.zh: 「耳」表示耳朵，如「耳鼻科」意为耳鼻喉科。
exp.en: 耳 means ear, as in 耳鼻科 (ENT clinic).

q.zh: 汉字「手」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 手 mean?

exp.zh: 「手」表示手，如「手紙」意为信件。
exp.en: 手 means hand, as in 手紙 (letter).

q.zh: 汉字「足」的意思是？
q.en: What does the Kanji 足 mean?

exp.zh: 「足」表示脚、腿，如「足りる」意为足够。
exp.en: 足 means foot or leg, as in 足りる (to be enough).

papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：平假名与基础问候

q.zh: “こんにちは”在中文里是什么意思？
q.en: What does "こんにちは" mean in English?

exp.zh: こんにちは（Konnichiwa）是日语中最常用的白天问候语，意为“你好”
exp.en: こんにちは (Konnichiwa) is the most common daytime greeting in Japanese, meaning "Hello"

q.zh: 平假名“さ”的正确罗马字发音是？
q.en: What is the correct Romaji pronunciation for the Hiragana "さ"?

exp.zh: さ 属于 サ 行假名，读作 sa
exp.en: さ belongs to the Sa-row假名 and is pronounced as "sa"

q.zh: “ありがとう”的意思是？
q.en: What is the meaning of "ありがとう"?

exp.zh: ありがとう（Arigatou）是表达感谢的常用语，意为“谢谢”
exp.en: ありがとう (Arigatou) is a common expression used to say "Thank you"

q.zh: “すみません”通常在什么场合使用？
q.en: When is "すみません" typically used?

zh: 向人打招呼或道歉（不好意思/对不起）
en: To get someone's attention or apologize (Excuse me / I'm sorry)

exp.zh: すみません（Sumimasen）用于引起他人注意（不好意思）或表示轻微道歉（对不起）
exp.en: すみません (Sumimasen) is used to get attention ("Excuse me") or express a mild apology ("I'm sorry")

q.zh: 平假名“ねこ”对应的中文法含义是？
q.en: What does the Hiragana "ねこ" refer to?

exp.zh: ねこ（Neko）在日语中写作汉字“猫”，意为猫
exp.en: ねこ (Neko) is written as "猫" in Kanji, which means "Cat"

q.zh: 片假名“カメラ”表示什么？
q.en: What does the Katakana "カメラ" mean?

exp.zh: カメラ（Kamera）来自外来语 Camera，意为相机
exp.en: カメラ (Kamera) comes from the English loanword "Camera"

q.zh: 表达“我开动了（吃饭前说）”的日语是？
q.en: Which phrase is used before eating a meal ("Bon appétit")?

exp.zh: いただきます（Itadakimasu）是日式饮食文化中用餐前说的礼貌用语
exp.en: いただきます (Itadakimasu) is a polite expression said before eating in Japanese culture

q.zh: “さようなら”的意思是？
q.en: What does "さようなら" mean?

exp.zh: さようなら（Sayounara）表示告别，即“再见”
exp.en: さようなら (Sayounara) means "Goodbye"

q.zh: 平假名“いぬ”指的是哪种动物？
q.en: What animal does the Hiragana "いぬ" refer to?

exp.zh: いぬ（Inu）汉字写作“犬”，即“狗”
exp.en: いぬ (Inu) is written as "犬" in Kanji, which means "Dog"

q.zh: “おはようございます”适用于哪个时间段？
q.en: When is "おはようございます" used?

exp.zh: おはようございます（Ohayou gozaimasu）是早晨使用的礼貌问候语
exp.en: おはようございます (Ohayou gozaimasu) is a polite morning greeting ("Good morning")

papers.titleZh: 试卷 2：指示代词与数字基础

q.zh: 日语数字“三（さん）”对应的发音是？
q.en: What is the Japanese pronunciation for the number "3 (さん)"?

exp.zh: 3=さん(san)
exp.en: 3=さん(san)

q.zh: “これ”指的是距离谁较近的事物？
q.en: What does "これ" refer to?

zh: 远处的第三方（那个远处的）
en: Something far from both (That over there)

exp.zh: これ（Kore）是指示代词，表示离说话人近的东西，“这个”
exp.en: これ (Kore) is a demonstrative pronoun meaning "this" (near the speaker)

q.zh: “それは何（なん）ですか”的中文意思是？
q.en: What does "それは何（なん）ですか" mean?

exp.zh: それ（那个）+ は（助词）+ 何（什么）+ ですか（疑问语气）= 那是什么？
exp.en: それ (that) + は (particle) + 何 (what) + ですか (question mark) = "What is that?

q.zh: 片假名“パン”的意思是？
q.en: What does the Katakana "パン" mean?

exp.zh: パン（Pan）源自葡萄牙语 pão，意为面包
exp.en: パン (Pan) comes from the Portuguese word "pão", meaning "Bread"

q.zh: 数字“10”在日语里的读音是？
q.en: How do you pronounce the number "10" in Japanese?

exp.zh: 10 在日语里读作 じゅう (Juu)
exp.en: The number 10 is pronounced as じゅう (Juu)

q.zh: 表示“远处的那个事物”应该用哪个词？
q.en: Which word refers to an object far from both the speaker and the listener?

exp.zh: あれ（Are）用于指代距离说话人和听话人都较远的事物（那个）
exp.en: あれ (Are) refers to an object far from both people ("that over there")

q.zh: “水（みず）”的意思是？
q.en: What does "水（みず）" mean?

exp.zh: 水（みず / Mizu）即为普通饮用水
exp.en: 水 (みず / Mizu) means "Water"

q.zh: 问句后缀“〜か”的作用是？
q.en: What is the function of the sentence-ending particle "〜か"?

exp.zh: 在句末加上助词“か”，相当于中文的“吗”，用于构成疑问句
exp.en: Adding "か" at the end of a sentence turns it into a question

q.zh: “はい”在答句中表示什么意思？
q.en: What does "はい" mean in an answer?

exp.zh: はい（Hai）表示应答或肯定，意为“是的/好的”
exp.en: はい (Hai) is used to express agreement or affirmation ("Yes / Okay")

q.zh: “いいえ”的中文意思是？
q.en: What does "いいえ" mean?

exp.zh: いいえ（Iie）用于否定回答，意为“不/不是”
exp.en: いいえ (Iie) is used for negative responses ("No")

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：基础判断句与名词助词

q.zh: “わたしは学生（がくせい）です”的意思是？
q.en: What does "わたしは学生（がくせい）です" mean?

exp.zh: わたし（我）+ は（提示主语）+ がくせい（学生）+ です（是）= 我是学生
exp.en: わたし (I) + は (topic particle) + 学生/がくせい (student) + です (am/is/are) = "I am a student."

q.zh: 助词“は”作为主语提示助词时，实际发音是？
q.en: How is the particle "は" pronounced when used as a topic marker?

exp.zh: 假名“は”作为句中助词使用时，读作“wa”
exp.en: When "は" functions as a grammatical particle in a sentence, it is pronounced as "wa"

q.zh: 否定句“〜ではありません”表示什么意思？
q.en: What does the negative ending "〜ではありません" mean?

exp.zh: ではありません（Dewa arimasen）是判断句 です 的礼貌否定形式，“不是……”
exp.en: ではありません (Dewa arimasen) is the polite negative form of です ("is not / am not")

q.zh: “先生（せんせい）”在日语中通常指什么职业？
q.en: What profession does "先生（せんせい）" usually refer to?

exp.zh: 先生（Sensei）在日语中用来尊称教师、医生、律师等专业人士
exp.en: 先生 (Sensei) is used as an honorific title for teachers, doctors, lawyers, and professionals

q.zh: “本（ほん）”对应的中文含义是？
q.en: What does "本（ほん）" mean?

exp.zh: 本（ほん / Hon）意为“书本”
exp.en: 本 (ほん / Hon) means "Book"

q.zh: 助词“の”的主要功能相当于中文的？
q.en: What English word best corresponds to the particle "の"?

exp.zh: 助词“の”连接两个名词，表示所属或限定关系，相当于“的”（如：わたしの本 = 我的书）
exp.en: The particle "の" connects two nouns to show possession or relationship (e.g., わたしの本 = My book)

q.zh: “わたしの本”翻译成中文是？
q.en: How do you translate "わたしの本"?

exp.zh: わたし（我）+ の（的）+ 本（书）= 我的书
exp.en: わたし (I) + の (possessive) + 本 (book) = "My book"

q.zh: “日本人（にほんじん）”的意思是？
q.en: What does "日本人（にほんじん）" mean?

exp.zh: 国家名 + 人/じん（jin）表示该国的人 = 日本/にほん (Ni hon) + 人/じん (jin)
exp.en: Country name + 人/じん (jin) refers to a person of that nationality = 日本/にほん (Ni hon) + 人/じん (jin)

q.zh: 片假名“トイレ”指什么地方？
q.en: What place does the Katakana "トイレ" refer to?

exp.zh: トイレ（Toire）源自英语 Toilet，意为洗手间
exp.en: トイレ (Toire) comes from the English word "Toilet"

q.zh: “どなた”或“だれ”用于询问什么？
q.en: What are "どなた" or "だれ" used to ask?

exp.zh: だれ / どなた（礼貌形）表示疑问代词“谁”
exp.en: だれ / どなた (polite) are question words meaning "Who"

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：场所、时间与简单动词

q.zh: “ここ”表示什么位置？
q.en: What location does "ここ" refer to?

exp.zh: ここ（Koko）表示距离说话人近的地点，“这里”
exp.en: ここ (Koko) refers to the location near the speaker ("Here")

q.zh: “どこですか”是在询问什么？
q.en: What does "どこですか" ask?

exp.zh: どこ（哪里）+ ですか（疑问）= 在哪里？
exp.en: どこ (Where) + ですか (question mark) = "Where is it?

q.zh: “今（いま）”的意思是？
q.en: What does "今（いま）" mean?

exp.zh: 今（いま / Ima）意为“现在”
exp.en: 今 (いま / Ima) means "Now"

q.zh: 表达“几点”的日语疑问词是？
q.en: Which question word means "What time"?

exp.zh: 何時（なんじ / Nan-ji）表示“几点钟”
exp.en: 何時 (なんじ / Nan-ji) means "What time"

q.zh: 动词“行（い）きます”的意思是？
q.en: What does the verb "行（い）きます" mean?

exp.zh: 行きます（Ikimasu）意为“去”
exp.en: 行きます (Ikimasu) means "To go"

q.zh: 动词“来（き）ます”的意思是？
q.en: What does the verb "来（き）ます" mean?

exp.zh: 来ます（Kimasu）意为“来”
exp.en: 来ます (Kimasu) means "To come"

q.zh: “今日（きょう）”表示什么时间？
q.en: What time frame does "今日（きょう）" refer to?

exp.zh: 今日（きょう / Kyou）意为“今天”
exp.en: 今日 (きょう / Kyou) means "Today"

q.zh: “明日（あした）”的意思是？
q.en: What does "明日（あした）" mean?

exp.zh: 明日（あした / Ashita）意为“明天”
exp.en: 明日 (あした / Ashita) means "Tomorrow"

q.zh: 片假名“レストラン”是指什么场所？
q.en: What place does the Katakana "レストラン" refer to?

exp.zh: レストラン（Resutoran）源自 Restaurant，意为餐厅
exp.en: レストラン (Resutoran) comes from the English word "Restaurant"

q.zh: “いくらですか”用于询问什么？
q.en: What is "いくらですか" used to ask?

exp.zh: いくら（Ikura）用于询问商品或服务的价格，意为“多少钱？”
exp.en: いくら (Ikura) is used to ask for the price of an item ("How much is it?")

papers.titleZh: 试卷 5：日常活动与基础宾语

q.zh: 动词“食（た）べます”的意思是？
q.en: What does the verb "食（た）べます" mean?

exp.zh: 食べます（Tabemasu）意为“吃”
exp.en: 食べます (Tabemasu) means "To eat"

q.zh: “飲（の）みます”表示什么动作？
q.en: What action does "飲（の）みます" express?

exp.zh: 饮みます（Nomimasu）意为“喝”
exp.en: 飲みます (Nomimasu) means "To drink"

q.zh: 助词“を”在句子中的作用是？
q.en: What is the function of the particle "を"?

en: Mark the direct object of an action

exp.zh: 助词“を”（读作 o）放在名词后，提示后续动词的作用对象（直接宾语）
exp.en: The particle "を" (pronounced "o") follows a noun to indicate the direct object of the verb

q.zh: “ご飯（はん）を食べます”的意思是？
q.en: What does "ご飯（はん）を食べます" mean?

exp.zh: ご飯（饭）+ を（宾语助词）+ 食べます（吃）= 吃饭
exp.en: ご飯 (meal/rice) + を (object particle) + 食べます (eat) = "Eat a meal"

q.zh: “水（みず）を飲みます”翻译为？
q.en: How do you translate "水（みず）を飲みます"?

exp.zh: 水（みず）+ を + 飲みます（喝）= 喝水
exp.en: 水/みず (water) + を + 飲みます (drink) = "Drink water"

q.zh: 动词“見（み）ます”的意思是？
q.en: What does the verb "見（み）ます" mean?

exp.zh: 見ます（Mimasu）意为“看”（如看电视、看电影）
exp.en: 見ます (Mimasu) means "To see" or "To watch" (e.g., watching TV)

q.zh: “買（か）います”的意思是？
q.en: What does "買（か）います" mean?

exp.zh: 买います（Kaimasu）意为“购买”
exp.en: 買います (Kaimasu) means "To buy"

q.zh: “新聞（しんぶん）”在日语里是指？
q.en: What does "新聞（しんぶん）" mean in Japanese?

exp.zh: 新聞（しんぶん / Shinbun）在日语里的意思是“报纸”
exp.en: 新聞 (しんぶん / Shinbun) means "Newspaper"

q.zh: “テレビを見ます”的意思是？
q.en: What does "テレビを見ます" mean?

exp.zh: テレビ（电视）+ を + 見ます（看）= 看电视
exp.en: テレビ (TV) + を + 見ます (watch) = "Watch TV"

q.zh: 动词否定形式“〜ません”表示什么？
q.en: What does the verb ending "〜ません" express?

exp.zh: 〜ません（masen）是动词 ます 形的礼貌否定式，表示不进行某种动作
exp.en: 〜ません (masen) is the polite negative form of verbs, indicating that an action is not/will not be performed

papers.titleZh: 试卷 1：动词变形 — て形与た形

q.zh: 动词「食べる」的て形是？
q.en: What is the te-form of the verb 食べる?

exp.zh: 食べる是二类动词（る动词），て形直接去る加て，读作 tabete。
exp.en: 食べる is a ru-verb: drop る and add て, read as tabete.

q.zh: 动词「飲む」的て形是？
q.en: What is the te-form of the verb 飲む?

exp.zh: む/ぶ/ぬ结尾的动词，て形变为んで，读作 nonde。
exp.en: Verbs ending in む/ぶ/ぬ change to んで, read as nonde.

q.zh: 动词「書く」的て形是？
q.en: What is the te-form of the verb 書く?

exp.zh: く结尾的动词，て形变为いて，读作 kaite。例外：行く→行って。
exp.en: Verbs ending in く become いて, read as kaite. Exception: 行く → 行って.

q.zh: 动词「話す」的て形是？
q.en: What is the te-form of the verb 話す?

exp.zh: す结尾的动词，て形变为して，读作 hanashite。
exp.en: Verbs ending in す become して, read as hanashite.

q.zh: 动词「待つ」的て形是？
q.en: What is the te-form of the verb 待つ?

exp.zh: つ/る结尾的动词，て形变为って（促音便），读作 matte。
exp.en: Verbs ending in つ/る become って, read as matte.

q.zh: 动词「遊ぶ」的て形是？
q.en: What is the te-form of the verb 遊ぶ?

exp.zh: ぶ结尾的动词，て形变为んで，读作 asonde。
exp.en: Verbs ending in ぶ become んで, read as asonde.

q.zh: 动词「死ぬ」的て形是？
q.en: What is the te-form of the verb 死ぬ?

exp.zh: ぬ结尾的动词，て形变为んで，读作 shinde。
exp.en: Verbs ending in ぬ become んで, read as shinde.

q.zh: 动词「読む」的た形是？
q.en: What is the ta-form of the verb 読む?

exp.zh: た形变化规则与て形相同，て/で换成た/だ，读作 yonda。
exp.en: The ta-form follows the te-form pattern, replacing て/で with た/だ, read as yonda.

q.zh: 动词「行く」的て形是？（注意例外）
q.en: What is the te-form of the verb 行く? (Watch the exception)

exp.zh: 行く虽然以く结尾，但属于特殊例外，て形是行って，读作 itte。
exp.en: 行く ends in く but is an exception: its te-form is 行って, read as itte.

q.zh: 动词「する」的て形是？
q.en: What is the te-form of the verb する?

exp.zh: する是不规则动词，て形是して，读作 shite。
exp.en: する is an irregular verb; its te-form is して, read as shite.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 2：形容词 — い形容词与な形容词

q.zh: い形容词「高い」的否定形（现在）是？
q.en: What is the negative (present) form of the i-adjective 高い?

exp.zh: い形容词否定：词尾い换成く，加ない。读作 takakunai。
exp.en: i-adjectives: replace い with く and add ない, read as takakunai.

q.zh: な形容词「静か」的否定形（现在）是？
q.en: What is the negative (present) form of the na-adjective 静か?

exp.zh: な形容词否定：加ではない（或じゃない）。读作 shizuka dewa nai。
exp.en: na-adjectives: add ではない (or じゃない), read as shizuka dewa nai.

q.zh: い形容词「おいしい」的过去肯定形是？
q.en: What is the past affirmative form of the i-adjective おいしい?

exp.zh: い形容词过去式：词尾い换成かった。读作 oishikatta。
exp.en: i-adjective past tense: replace い with かった, read as oishikatta.

q.zh: な形容词「元気」的过去肯定形是？
q.en: What is the past affirmative form of the na-adjective 元気?

exp.zh: な形容词过去式：加だった。读作 genki datta。
exp.en: na-adjective past tense: add だった, read as genki datta.

q.zh: い形容词「いい」的否定形是？（特殊）
q.en: What is the negative form of the i-adjective いい? (Exception)

exp.zh: いい是特殊形容词，否定形是よくない（不是いくない），读作 yokunai。
exp.en: いい is irregular: negative is よくない, read as yokunai.

q.zh: 形容词「きれい」属于哪一类？
q.en: Which type of adjective is きれい?

exp.zh: きれい虽然词尾是い，但实际是な形容词（きれいな花）。
exp.en: Despite ending in い, きれい is a na-adjective (きれいな花).

q.zh: い形容词「赤い」修饰名词时的形式是？
q.en: How does the i-adjective 赤い modify a noun?

exp.zh: い形容词直接修饰名词，不需加な或の。读作 akai kuruma。
exp.en: i-adjectives directly modify nouns. Read as akai kuruma.

q.zh: な形容词「便利」修饰名词时的形式是？
q.en: How does the na-adjective 便利 modify a noun?

exp.zh: な形容词修饰名词时加な。读作 benrina dougu。
exp.en: na-adjectives add な before nouns. Read as benrina dougu.

q.zh: い形容词「寒い」修饰动词时变成？
q.en: How does the i-adjective 寒い become an adverb?

exp.zh: い形容词副词化：词尾い换成く。读作 samuku（例：寒くなる）。
exp.en: i-adverbs: replace い with く. Read as samuku (e.g. 寒くなる).

q.zh: な形容词「上手」修饰动词时变成？
q.en: How does the na-adjective 上手 become an adverb?

exp.zh: な形容词副词化：加に。读作 jouzu ni（例：上手に話す）。
exp.en: na-adverbs: add に. Read as jouzu ni (e.g. 上手に話す).

papers.titleZh: 试卷 3：存在句 — あります与います

q.zh: 「本があります」应该用哪个动词？
q.en: Which verb is used in 本___?

exp.zh: あります用于无生命事物（书、物品等）。
exp.en: あります is used for inanimate things such as books and objects.

q.zh: 「猫がいます」应该用哪个动词？
q.en: Which verb is used in 猫___?

exp.zh: います用于有生命的事物（人或动物）。
exp.en: います is used for living things like people and animals.

q.zh: 「〜が___」中，无生命事物应该填？
q.en: In 〜が___, which verb is used for inanimate things?

exp.zh: 无生命（物品、植物、抽象概念）用あります。
exp.en: Inanimate things (objects, plants, abstract concepts) use あります.

q.zh: 「〜が___」中，人或有生命动物应该填？
q.en: In 〜が___, which verb is used for people or living animals?

exp.zh: 有生命的人或动物用います。
exp.en: Living people or animals use います.

q.zh: 「机の上___本があります」应该填哪个助词？
q.en: Which particle fills the blank in 机の上___本があります?

exp.zh: 「〜に〜があります」是存在句的固定句型。
exp.en: 〜に〜があります is the fixed pattern for existence.

q.zh: 「公園___子供がいます」应该填哪个助词？
q.en: Which particle fills the blank in 公園___子供がいます?

exp.zh: 表示场所的助词是に。
exp.en: に marks the location in existence sentences.

q.zh: 问「有…吗？」的正确句型是？
q.en: Which is the correct pattern to ask 'Is there ...?'

exp.zh: 疑问句：〜がありますか / 〜がいますか。
exp.en: Questions use 〜がありますか / 〜がいますか.

q.zh: 「冷蔵庫に牛乳があります」的意思是？
q.en: Which is the meaning of 冷蔵庫に牛乳があります?

exp.zh: 场所に + 物が + あります = 在…有…。
exp.en: Place に + object が + あります = there is ... at ...

q.zh: 「部屋に誰がいますか」的正确句型使用了哪个动词？
q.en: Which verb is used in 部屋に誰がいますか?

exp.zh: 誰（谁）指人，用います提问。
exp.en: 誰 (who) refers to people, so います is used.

q.zh: 被问「何がありますか」时，回答应该用？
q.en: When asked 何がありますか, what should the answer use?

exp.zh: 何（什么）指物，用あります回答。
exp.en: 何 (what) refers to objects, so あります is used.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 4：日常会话 — 邀请、拒绝、请求
papers.titleEn: Paper 4: Daily Conversation — Inviting, Declining, Requesting

q.zh: 邀请别人一起去，应该用？
q.en: Which phrase invites someone to go together?

exp.zh: 〜ませんか是礼貌的邀请句型。
exp.en: 〜ませんか is the polite invitation pattern.

q.zh: 「〜ませんか」主要用于？
q.en: What is 〜ませんか mainly used for?

exp.zh: 〜ませんか：礼貌地邀请对方。
exp.en: 〜ませんか: politely invite someone.

q.zh: 礼貌地拒绝邀请，应该用？
q.en: Which phrase politely declines an invitation?

exp.zh: 「すみません、ちょっと…」是典型的委婉拒绝。
exp.en: すみません、ちょっと… is a typical soft refusal.

q.zh: 提议一起做某事，应该用？
q.en: Which ending suggests doing something together?

exp.zh: 〜ましょう：提议一起做某事。
exp.en: 〜ましょう: suggest doing something together.

q.zh: 请求别人做某事，应该用？
q.en: Which ending makes a polite request?

exp.zh: 〜てください：请求对方做某事。
exp.en: 〜てください: polite request.

q.zh: 请求别人不要做某事，应该用？
q.en: Which ending makes a polite negative request?

exp.zh: 〜ないでください：请求对方不要做某事。
exp.en: 〜ないでください: polite negative request.

q.zh: 请求许可（可以…吗？），应该用？
q.en: Which pattern is used to ask permission?

exp.zh: 〜てもいいですか：请求许可。
exp.en: 〜てもいいですか: asking for permission.

q.zh: 表示禁止（不可以…），应该用？
q.en: Which pattern expresses prohibition?

exp.zh: 〜てはいけません：表示禁止。
exp.en: 〜てはいけません: prohibition.

q.zh: 请求别人帮忙，应该用？
q.en: Which phrase asks someone for a favor?

zh: 手伝ってくれませんか
en: 手伝ってくれませんか

exp.zh: 〜てくれませんか：礼貌地请求对方帮忙。
exp.en: 〜てくれませんか: politely ask someone for a favor.

q.zh: 礼貌地请求或委托时，应该用？
q.en: Which phrase is used to politely request or entrust?

exp.zh: 〜をお願いします：礼貌地请求或委托。
exp.en: 〜をお願いします: polite request or entrust.

papers.titleZh: 试卷 5：时间表达 — 年月日与频率

q.zh: 「去年」读作？
q.en: How is 去年 read?

exp.zh: 去年读作きょねん，意为去年。
exp.en: 去年 is read きょねん, meaning last year.

q.zh: 「来年」读作？
q.en: How is 来年 read?

exp.zh: 来年读作らいねん，意为明年。
exp.en: 来年 is read らいねん, meaning next year.

q.zh: 「毎日」读作？
q.en: How is 毎日 read?

exp.zh: 毎日读作まいにち，意为每天。
exp.en: 毎日 is read まいにち, meaning every day.

q.zh: 「〜時〜分」中，「時」读作？
q.en: In 〜時〜分, how is 時 read?

exp.zh: 〜時读作〜じ（如 3 時 = さんじ）。
exp.en: 〜時 is read 〜じ (e.g. 3 時 = さんじ).

q.zh: 「午前」的意思是？
q.en: What does 午前 mean?

exp.zh: 午前（ごぜん）：上午/早上。
exp.en: 午前 (ごぜん): AM / morning.

q.zh: 「午後」的意思是？
q.en: What does 午後 mean?

exp.zh: 午後（ごご）：下午。
exp.en: 午後 (ごご): PM / afternoon.

q.zh: 「月曜日___金曜日まで」应该填哪个助词？
q.en: Which particle fills the blank in 月曜日___金曜日まで?

exp.zh: 〜から〜まで：从…到…。
exp.en: 〜から〜まで: from ... to ...

q.zh: 表示「总是」的日语是？
q.en: Which word means 'always'?

exp.zh: いつも：总是、经常。
exp.en: いつも: always.

q.zh: 表示「偶尔」的日语是？
q.en: Which word means 'occasionally'?

exp.zh: たまに：偶尔、有时候。
exp.en: たまに: occasionally.

q.zh: 「〜前に」的意思是？
q.en: What does 〜前に mean?

exp.zh: 〜前に：在…之前（时间）。
exp.en: 〜前に: before (in time).
